mapper.sql: select f.favorite_id, f.user_id, u.nick_name, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.create_time, case when f.target_type = 'vehicle' then v.model_name when f.target_type = 'station' then s.station_name when f.target_type = 'article' then concat('文章ID:', f.target_id) else '未知类型' end as target_name, case when f.target_type = 'vehicle' then v.title when f.target_type = 'station' then s.address when f.target_type = 'article' then '文章内容预览' else '' end as target_address, case when f.target_type = 'vehicle' then v.guide_price else 0 end as target_price, v.vehicle_type as target_vehicle_type, v.stock as target_stock, s.total_piles as target_piles, s.available_piles as target_available_piles, case when f.target_type = 'vehicle' then v.status when f.target_type = 'station' then s.station_status else '1' end as target_status from stad_user_favorite f left join sys_user u on f.user_id = u.user_id left join stad_vehicle v on f.target_type = 'vehicle' and f.target_id = v.vehicle_id left join stad_charging_station s on f.target_type = 'station' and f.target_id = s.station_id
